issueDescription: Observed dark brown lesions near the soil line on young gram plants. Patches of 10-15 plants are wilting suddenly after the first light irrigation. Roots show dark rotting.
responseNotes: Symptoms are characteristic of Rhizoctonia / Sclerotium collar rot triggered by wet soil conditions. Avoid excess ponding. Drench root zone immediately with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/L or carbendazim if fungal spread is rapid. Apply bio-formulations during evening hours.

issueDescription: Soil test report indicates available Zinc at 0.48 ppm (below critical limit of 0.6 ppm). Want advice on whether to apply Zinc Sulphate or Zinc Solubilizing Bio-inoculant along with PSB.
